question: Can one continuing Brain.live life learn to alternate two actions under identical drive from the world's reward alone, with no teacher, when the only state that can carry the beat is the copy of its own last command? Measured against the same brain without the copy, the copy on the composed reward defaults, an always-learning loop, zero eligibility decay, a frozen brain, a tabular learner given the same one bit, and uniform random.

world.observation: the frozen input module's drive event (coordinate 0 at 1.0) at every moment; pause events are all zeros and a distractor event sets coordinate 1 alone, in the disturbance forks only
world.payment: the outcome of the preceding action, paid at the next moment through live(x, reward=[r], done=[False]); the first step of a life earns repeat; a refused answer is a missed step that earns repeat
world.no_teacher: no label, clock, phase or previous action enters any observation

life.note: the scored window is the last 64 moments of the 600-moment life, still paid; the probe checkpoint at moment 400 holds the last action awaiting its outcome and feeds the greedy probe, the continuing twin and the disturbance forks

operating_point.note: the key-door nursery's declared point (benchmarks/keydoor/protocol.json: trace 0.3, eta 0.1, lam 0.95, gamma 0.95, eta_critic 5.0, eta_bias eta/10 by the composed rule) with the rhythm/2 efference genes; the defaults arm keeps the composed ActorCriticConfig as the operating-point control, and nocopy the same point without the copy

arousal.note: the key-door nursery's arousal genes with youth 100 moments and need 0.5, half the income of a perfect walker; need 0 is a development variant

gates.statement: over the confirmation founders of the live arm, at least share of five alternate in at least window_alternation of the last 64 moments, their greedy probe alternates in at least greedy_alternation of its 32 acts, they spend at most window_aroused of the last 64 moments aroused, and their twin continues identically; every founder stays in the denominator and every other arm is reported

policy.selection: the operating point and the need gene are selected on the development seeds only; the confirmation seeds are fresh; no default changes; the copy is a gene with zero as its control
policy.refusal: a refused answer is a missed step: no action, the world pays repeat, the life continues
policy.denominator: every planned founder stays in the denominator

development: selected on development seeds 0-5 with every arm run (results/development-reward-*.json.gz): at this point (need 0.5, youth 100, working trace 0.3) the live arm alternates in 1.00 of the window on all six founders, is calm, its greedy probe alternates at 1.00 and every twin continues identically; need 0 gives the same six passes while the brain without the copy calms into holding one action (0.02, aroused 0.03); youth 0 (born calm) leaves three of six founders in a limp of two changed steps in three (0.67), paid above the need and so never roused; working trace 3.0, the supervised chamber's recipe, degrades every learning arm (live 0.62). The composed reward defaults reach 0.82 with the copy; the always-learning step loop reaches 0.98 while aroused at every moment; zero eligibility decay reaches 1.00 at this delay of one; the frozen founder holds (0.00); the tabular learner given the last action reaches 0.95; uniform random 0.50.
